'''Tiger Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of 4 [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] employed by [[Airam Clans|Airam]] [[Clan leader]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] collaborator [[Ilay]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Ilay began collaborating with [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] Fleet Admiral [[Wooyou Senn]]. She was in the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] [[Kala'din (starship)|''Kala'din'']] to make new negotiations following the [[Ambush in the Cron Drift]]. Tiger Squadron and T-wing Squadrons [[Cobalt Squadron (R60 T-wing interceptor)|Cobalt Squadron]] and [[Crimson Squadron (Airam)|Crimson Squadron]] were assigned to provide her ship escort. Rival Clan Leader [[Tamaron]] managed to locate her meeting and sent [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] to capture her.

Despite her escorts and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and lastly [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']], the Rebels managed to hold off the enemy fighters and disabled the Dreadnaught and provided support for [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Storm (CR90 corvette)|''Storm'']] to board and capture Ilay.
